description: A small stack of playing cards sits on the pink surface, with an orange rubber band lying nearby. The left hand reaches in and lifts the cards, holding them steady as a left-hand object, while the right hand pulls and stretches the rubber band over the middle of the stack, wrapping and adjusting it back and forth to tighten and then loosen it, briefly making the cards and band a two-hand object before the right hand releases tension again.
